Aldwyn is an independent, one-person web studio in Ireland. You’ll deal directly with the person designing and building your website.

For small businesses starting online, replacing an outdated site or improving what they already have.

The idea behind Aldwyn

A website is a lot of
small decisions.
They should add up.

Our starting point is practical: can someone understand your services, find the information they need and work out how to contact you?

The design supports those tasks. Clear content and useful pages come before features that do not help your visitors.

How the work happens

A process you
can follow.

  1. 01

    Start with the business

    Who is the site for? What do they need to know? We turn that conversation into a page plan, content responsibilities and an agreed scope.

  2. 02

    Give it a direction

    Bring the content, typography, colour and layouts together. You review the direction at agreed stages, while there is room to make useful changes.

  3. 03

    Build, check, hand over

    Build the agreed pages, test the key routes and review the result together. Launch follows your approval, with ownership and next steps explained.
